newsitem.title: USA: Centex sees 1998 results better than 1997.
newsitem.headline: Centex sees 1998 results better than 1997.

text.p: Centex Corp said Monday that it believes its financial results should improve in fiscal 1998 over the record fiscal 1997 level.
The company said the higher interest rates in recent months had slowed both home sales and mortgage applications.

The company said that if interest rates remain at or near current levels, its Home Building margins should continue to increase and Home Building results should improve in fiscal 1998. The company also said it expects better results from its other businesses, including positive results from Contracting and Construction Services.
